ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, there is a large rectangle ABCD, with A at the lower left, B at the lower right, C at the upper right, and D at the upper left; AB is the horizontal side of the bottom edge, and BC is the vertical side on the right. Point E is on the upper side DC, point F is on the lower side AB, and the vertical line segment EF divides the large rectangle into left and right parts; the vertices of the small rectangle on the right can be regarded in order as B-C-E-F. Reasoning: The problem gives rectangle ABCD ∼ rectangle BCEF, and AB = 8, BC = 6. According to the corresponding order of the names of the similar rectangles, AB corresponds to BC, and BC corresponds to CE. Therefore there is the proportional relationship AB/BC = BC/CE. Substitute the values: 8/6 = 6/CE. Cross-multiplying gives 8CE = 36, so CE = 36/8 = 9/2.
